notes: The impossibility of (6b) follows from the structure in (9a) assuming that the dative P is overt and can never be dropped. Thus, (9a) is parallel to English *John shelved the book on. The partial (boldfaced) structure for (6b) is given in (9a), for (7b) in (9b).
